'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbass]], [[Russia–NATO relations]]
**[[Russia]] deploys more troops to the [[Russia–Ukraine border]] as tensions escalate between the U.S., Russia, and [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/04/09/world/europe/russia-ukraine-war-troops-intervention.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria]]
**Eleven [[Nigerian Army]] troops, including an officer, are killed in an [[ambush]] while on patrol in [[Benue State]]. It is unclear who carried out the attack. [https://www.msn.com/en-in/news/world/eleven-soldiers-killed-in-attack-in-nigeria/ar-BB1ftIPM?ocid=msedgntp (MSN)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**[[Indian Police Service|Police]] and [[Indian Armed Forces|military]] officials in [[India]] claim the eradication of [[Islamist]] [[separatist]] [[terrorism in India|terror]] group [[Ansar Ghazwat-ul-Hind]] following two [[military operation]]s today that killed seven people. [https://www.wionews.com/india-news/seven-terrorists-killed-by-security-forces-aguh-terror-outfit-wiped-out-in-jk-376274 (Wionews)]
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**[[Tatmadaw|Troops]] shoot and kill at least 83 people in [[Bago, Myanmar]], as [[State Administration Council|junta]] spokesman General [[Zaw Min Tun (general)|Zaw Min Tun]] says that the country is "returning to normal" as protests are "dwindling," and that government ministries and banks would resume full operations soon. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-politics/myanmar-junta-says-protests-are-dwindling-as-at-least-10-reported-killed-by-troops-idUSKBN2BW0ZC (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/10/myanmar-un-envoy-urges-no-fly-zone-as-army-crackdown-intensifies (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Death and funeral of Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh]]
**[[Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh|Prince Philip]], [[Duke of Edinburgh]] and the husband of [[Elizabeth II|Queen Elizabeth II]], dies at home in [[Windsor Castle]] aged 99. He was the longest-serving Royal Consort of the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/prince-philip-death-queen-duke-edinburgh-b1721690.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Forty people are killed during a road accident involving a bus in Kiwawa, [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. Thirty-one others are injured and hospitalized. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-crash/dozens-burned-alive-in-congo-bus-crash-idUSKBN2BW1PZ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*The [[La Soufrière (volcano)|La Soufrière]] volcano on [[Saint Vincent (Antilles)|Saint Vincent]], [[Saint Vincent and the Grenadines]] erupts, prompting the evacuation of 16,000 people. [https://apnews.com/article/puerto-rico-caribbean-volcanic-eruptions-latin-america-evacuations-1430a41cbaa02f20222b6b3e37dc2c05 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] reports a record 576 new confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 3,604. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2021/04/09/cambodia039s-daily-covid-19-cases-hit-all-time-high-of-576 (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports a record 131,968 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 13 million. [https://timesofindia.com/india/india-reports-a-record-131968-new-covid-19-infections/amp_articleshow/81980924.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The [[Government of Japan|government]] designates [[Tokyo]], [[Kyoto]], and nine other cities in [[Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]] for stricter measures, which include closing businesses at 8:00 p.m., in order to reduce the number of COVID-19 cases. These measures will be in effect from April 15 until May 5 for Kyoto and Okinawa and until May 11 for Tokyo. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/04/09/national/tokyo-kyoto-okinawa-covid-19-measures/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****The Drug Regulatory Authority grants Emergency Use Authorization for [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] vaccine. [https://www.geo.tv/latest/344291-drap-okays-emergency-authorisation-to-fifth-coronavirus-vaccine (Geo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[Prime Minister of South Korea|Prime Minister]] [[Chung Sye-kyun]] announces the closure of nightclubs, bars, and other nightly entertainment facilities in the [[Seoul Capital Area]] and [[Busan]] beginning April 15, along with the extension of [[social distancing]] measures for three weeks due to concerns about a fourth wave of the [[pandemic]]. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20210409001652315 (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] restricts the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] to people over 30 years old following reports of a possible link with rare [[blood clot]]ting cases. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1159004/greece-restricts-use-of-astrazeneca-vaccine-to-over-30s/ (Ekathimerini)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] surpasses 700,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://dailynewshungary.com/number-of-infections-exceeds-700000-recoveries-stand-at-420000/ (''Daily News Hungary'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] says that the [[United States]] has vaccinated 20% of their population. [https://www.usnews.com/news/national-news/articles/2021-04-09/cdc-20-of-us-population-fully-vaccinated-against-coronavirus (U.S. News & World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Governor of Michigan|Michigan Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] urges the [[Michigan|state]] to halt in-person classes, indoor dining, and youth sports for two weeks due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/2021/04/09/whitmer-michigan-coronavirus-covid-remote-school-sports-indoor-dining/7154274002/ (''Detroit Free Press'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nevada]], [[Lineage P.1]]
****[[Nevada]] reports its first three cases of the Lineage P.1 variant, which originated from [[Brazil]]. [https://www.reviewjournal.com/life/health/brazil-coronavirus-variant-found-in-nevada-2326045/ (''Las Vegas Review Journal'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
****[[Governor of New Jersey|New Jersey Governor]] [[Phil Murphy]] and his wife [[Tammy Murphy|Tammy]] receive their first doses of the [[Pfizer]] [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. Murphy also signs legislation providing [[United States dollar|$]]35 million in federal aid to restaurants, bars, and other businesses. [https://apnews.com/article/atlantic-city-new-jersey-legislation-coronavirus-pandemic-wineries-96a416a6e96a1c4d84a5203bef47411a (AP)]
***The U.S. surpasses 31 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/coronavirus-tally-global-cases-of-covid-19-top-134-million-and-us-death-toll-above-560000-2021-04-09 (MarketWatch)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] reports 24,130 new cases of COVID-19, a record for the fourth consecutive day, thereby bringing the total cases to nearly 2.5 million. [https://www.pagina12.com.ar/334681-otro-record-se-registraron-24-130-casos-de-coronavirus-en-ar (''Página 12'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Far-right terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**A 17-year-old boy appears in court to deny [[neo-Nazi]] [[terrorism in the United Kingdom|terror]] offences. [[Crown Prosecution Service|Prosecutors]] allege that he was planning an attack using [[3D printed firearm]]s. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/neo-nazi-terror-plots-uk-3d-guns-b1829106.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**Former member of the [[Board of the Parliament of Catalonia|Catalan parliament's bureau]] [[Joan Josep Nuet]] is condemned to eight months of disqualification for committing a crime of serious disobedience to the [[Constitutional Court (Spain)|Spanish Constitutional Court]] for voting in favor of the processing of the unconstitutional [[Law on the Referendum on Self-determination of Catalonia]]. [https://amp.elmundo.es/espana/2021/04/09/60702a4bfc6c83c14a8b462a.html (''El Mundo'')]
*[[2021 Northern Ireland riots]]
**Rioters again clash with [[police Service of Northern Ireland|police]] using [[petrol bomb]]s, stones, and fireworks as missiles. Nineteen officers are injured and in [[Belfast]] the force uses [[water cannon]]s for the first time in six years to repel attackers. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-56684571 (BBC News)]
*[[Giorgos Karaivaz]], a notable [[Greece|Greek]] journalist, is shot dead by two gunmen near his home in [[Athens]]. The murder appears to be connected to Karaivaz's investigations. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/9/greek-crime-journalist-shot-dead-outside-his-home-police (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Indonesia]] increases security measures nationwide in response to recent [[terrorism in Indonesia|terror]] attacks and announces plans to reopen [[Bali]], [[Banten]], and [[Bintan Regency|Bintan]] to foreign [[tourism in Indonesia|tourists]] as part of their plan to recover tourism following the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.ttgasia.com/2021/04/09/indonesia-tightens-security-at-tourist-spots-in-wake-of-terror-attacks/ (TTG Asia)]
*A [[Turkey|Turkish]] court in [[İzmir Province|İzmir]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] [[Gülen movement]] member Yusuf Bekmezci to 17 years and four months in prison after finding him guilty of managing an armed [[terrorism in Turkey|terrorist]] organisation. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/turkey/turkish-court-sentences-senior-feto-terrorist/2203443 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[Rai News]], ''[[Domani (newspaper)|Domani]]'', and ''[[The Guardian]]'' jointly allege [[Italy|Italian]] prosecutors wiretapped thousands of confidential conversations between [[human rights]] lawyers and clients. The claims relate to prosecutions against charity officials for running migrant rescue boats. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/09/italian-prosecutors-secretly-recorded-human-rights-lawyers (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Djiboutian presidential election]]
**[[Ismaïl Omar Guelleh]] is re-elected as the [[President of Djibouti]] for a fifth term, receiving more than 98 percent of the vote. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2021/04/10/Ismail-Omar-Guelleh-re-elected-president-of-Djibouti-with-98-58-of-vote (Al Arabiya)]
